description: Dept. of Fiscal Policy - Order made to amend the order published in Gaz. Ex. No. 1964/70 of 29.04.2016 by inserting item No. 1 (e)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - an amendment to the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989. It contains an order issued under Section 3 of this Act that modifies the schedule of a previous gazette notification. While it mentions Minister Ravi Karunanayake and his title, this is incidental to the main purpose of publishing a statutory instrument and regulatory amendment. The core content is about modifying excise duty regulations for specific motor vehicle imports, which falls under legal/regulatory framework changes rather than government personnel or structural matters.
